mapper.select: select id, level, name, label, type, color from cmdb_cientity_alertlevel order by level
mapper.insert: insert into cmdb_cientity_alertlevel (id, level, name, color, label, type) values (#{id}, #{level}, #{name}, #{color}, #{label}, #{type}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE label = #{label}, color = #{color}, level = #{level}, name = #{name}, type =#{type}
